name: EntitlementBalances
summary: The `balances` member body of the Entitlement replicated state: a prefix-varint delta count, the client's delta-count-zero branch (a strict zero-or-one presence flag and, when it is one, a prefix varint), then a prefix-varint element count and that many (u32be, u32be) pairs. Only the delta-count 0 branch has an instance, so the count is pinned to 0.
purpose: Name the member layout that the two-level presence mask selects (group 0 member 1 of codec.entitlement-replicated-state).

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint delta count read by 0x1430516a0 before it branches. 0 in the measured body; the non-zero chunked-map branch is recovered but has no instance, so the card bounds this field to 0.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The delta-count-zero branch of 0x143051960: a strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60, then one prefix varint when it is 1. Measured 01 0b.

fields.name: elements
fields.note: The prefix-varint element count and that many eight-byte elements. 432 in the measured body.

evidence.ref: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-3133.hex: 00 01 0b then b0 06 then 432 x 8 bytes; byte-exact round trip.
